content.text: I found several restrictions beyond the withdrawn Friday cutoff: weekends were blocked, durations had to be multiples of 30 minutes, and events had a mandatory 15-minute buffer. I’ll remove those, retain the required work-hour and lunch-start rules, and add support for string durations and console output.
